title: BNCI 2014-001 Motor Imagery dataset
description: The BNCI 2014-001 Motor Imagery dataset is a widely-used benchmark for brain-computer interface research, comprising EEG recordings from 9 healthy subjects performing four-class motor imagery tasks (left hand, right hand, feet, and tongue). Each subject completed two sessions with 6 runs per session, yielding 200 training and 240 test trials. The dataset features 22 EEG channels plus 3 EOG channels (25 total) sampled at 250 Hz with minimal preprocessing (bandpass filtering 0.05-200 Hz and 50 Hz notch filtering). Data are provided in two versions: original at 250 Hz and downsampled to 100 Hz using Chebyshev Type II filtering. This makes it a standard resource for evaluating multi-class motor imagery classification algorithms and cross-session transfer learning approaches.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a BrainAmp MR plus amplifier with 22 EEG channels and 3 EOG channels at 250 Hz sampling rate. Subjects performed cued motor imagery tasks lasting 4 seconds each, with visual arrow cues indicating the imagery class. Online filtering included bandpass 0.05-200 Hz and 50 Hz notch filtering. Data were recorded using BCI2000 software with reference at left mastoid. Two data versions are provided: original at 250 Hz and downsampled to 100 Hz using Chebyshev Type II filtering (filter order 10, stop band ripple 50 dB, stop band edge 49 Hz).
